title: Predicate Along a Computation
statement: Let $C$ be a contract for a multi-tape Turing machine, with index set $\iota$, fixed input, entry state $e$, and prescribed running time. Let $R(i,d,p)$ be a predicate on an index $i$, a starting configuration $d$, and a vector $p$ of work-tape head positions. For every $i\in\iota$ and starting configuration $d$ whose state is $e$ and which satisfies the contract precondition, $R$ holds of the vector of head positions after $u$ steps for every natural number $u$ with $u\leq C$’s prescribed running time on $i,d$.
hypotheses_covered: A contract C specifying the machine, entry state, exits, index set, fixed input, precondition, and running time
A predicate on an index, starting configuration, and vector of work-tape head positions
The starting configuration has state equal to the contract entry state
The starting configuration satisfies the contract precondition
The step count u is a natural number bounded above by the contract running time
